source_title: World of Warcraft: Forever News, Trailer, Guides, and More - GameRant
source_excerpt:
CARVE A NEW PATH - Azeroth, an untamed frontier begging to be explored. Step into World of Warcraft: Forever and quest through an iconic world reimagined with new and expanded zones, new gameplay enhancements, upgraded graphics, and more. ADVENTURE IS FOREVER - WoW: Forever is an invitation to take your first steps in a legendary world of untamed frontiers, warring factions, untold perils, and unseen mysteries. Experience an Azeroth that grows from the roots of WoW’s first age, continually evolving through regular content patches and updates that promise never-ending adventure. UNDISCOVERED VISTAS AWAIT - Journey through an updated and expanded Azeroth dense with new stories and secrets hidden across familiar vistas and never-before-seen locales. • Zephras Isle - Once a secluded island oasis in the sky, Zephras Isle now welcomes the next generation of WoW’s newest race – the Skyborne – to protect this floating island and secure its future. • Riverglades - A sprawling landscape in the Eastern Kingdom which shifts from lush hillsides to ruined keeps of old. • Mount Hyjal - Threats both old and new stalk the slopes of the mountain, eager to claim its power and destroy anyone daring enough to get in their way. EXPLORE UNTOLD STORIES - With over 1000+ new quests, new dungeons, and new secrets hidden around all corners, Azeroth promises a journey of discovery and surprise for both novice and veteran adventurers. SOAK IN BREATHTAKING EXPANSES - Improved lighting and upgraded environments invite you to fall in love with the intimidating expanses and beautiful vistas of Azeroth. TAKE UNKNOWN PATHS - Begin your next adventure as Azeroth’s newest race –the Skyborne – or as one of the newest class and race combos: the Forsaken Paladin or Dwarf Shaman. CLAIM NEW POWER - Rediscover a favorite class or journey as someone entirely different with revamps to all classes and specializations. EVERY JOURNEY MATTERS - WoW: Forever’s Legacy system rewards account-wide benefits every time you progress a character’s adventure. SYSTEM REVAMPS - Across the new Camping system, updates to Professions, and changes to Honor, each adventurer has new ways to play. SKYBORNE - Stand with a new race of windswept elves as their once-secluded home faces an existential threat. Follow the path of the Windshaper Horde or the High Order Alliance in your quest to defend Zephras Isle.
Come back to review this video game when it is released!
